answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 151377 Country: india Title: Islamic name for my son Question: Alhamdulillah Allah (SWT) blessed me a son. I want to put his name “Ali Hamdaan” or “Mohammad Hamdaan” please suggest which name is better? Also suggest some other Islamic names with good meaning. Answer ID: 151377 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1053/912/SN=8/1438) Both the names are good. However, the second name i.e. Muhammad Hamdan is far better. Also Abdullah, Ubaidullah, Abdul Muqtadir, Haris, Abu Dujanah are good names. You may choose any of them. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
